NewsArticle.Title: ISP Connection
NewsArticle.Content: 12:30 - 16:55, an Internet Service Provider near Dark Ages servers suffers internet latency. We are pressing the ISP to fix their error. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
